o1: Enables microtubule binding activity and Rho guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in axon regeneration and neuron remodeling. Is located in neuronal cell body and varicosity. Is expressed in the PLM neuron, nervous system, and spermatheca. Is part of the retrograde DLK-1 MAPK pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in immunodeficiency 62. Orthologous to several human genes including ARHGEF11 (Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 11).
